intro: Kanke Road, Morabadi & Bariatu is the residential north and north-east of Ranchi. Kanke Road heads out from Circular Road towards Kanke and its reservoir, with colonies such as Indrapuri Colony and Hatma behind the main road. Morabadi wraps around its large maidan, with flats and older houses in Van Vrindavan Colony, Adalhatu Colony and Dipatoli. Bariatu takes in Bariatu Road, the housing colony, Rani Bagan, Jora Talab and Sarhul Nagar. Across the zone, ready apartment buildings with two- and three-bedroom flats stand beside older independent houses and plots, so a tutor's first visit may start at a gate register or at a front door.

No railway runs through this part of the city, so every tutor arrives by road, usually by two-wheeler, auto or cab, which residents say are easy to find. Kanke Road links to the centre, while the Kanke-Patratu Road and the Ring Road join its northern end to the rest of the city. Morabadi has several ways in, from Morabadi Road and Karamtoli Road to Circular Road, and Bariatu relies on the Bajra-Bariatu Road and Joda Talab Road. Office closing time slows Kanke Road, Bariatu gets busy at peak hours, and large events at the Morabadi ground fill nearby roads, so choose lesson times with those in mind.

Families in the northern colonies usually find it easiest to work with a tutor who already lives up here rather than one crossing from the south. NXTutors lists tutors from Kanke Road, Morabadi and Bariatu first, then tutors who travel to the zone, then those from elsewhere in Ranchi, then online tutors, useful for students pairing school subjects with a specialist board or exam topic. Two or three matched tutors come back for each request, fees show on every profile before you book, and the first class is a free demo. Switching tutor later is free.
faqs: How do tutors reach Morabadi from other parts of Ranchi?

By road, with a choice of routes. Morabadi Road, Circular Road, Karamtoli Road, the Kanke-Patratu Road and the Bajra-Bariatu Road all lead in, so a tutor from Lalpur, Bariatu or Kanke Road can pick the least crowded one. Many families live in apartment buildings that keep a visitor register, so share the tutor's name early.
Is Bariatu mostly flats or houses?

Mostly flats. Ready apartment buildings with three-bedroom homes dominate Bariatu, alongside residential plots and older houses in the housing colony. Flats usually mean gate registration, while the colony's houses let the tutor go straight to the door. Peak-hour traffic builds on the local roads, so an after-school slot before the evening rush is easier.
What should families towards Kanke expect when booking a home tutor?

Fewer tutors crossing from the south. The road stretches a long way north towards Kanke and its reservoir, and evening office traffic on it makes long trips unreliable, so a tutor based in the northern colonies, or one who can use the Ring Road, suits regular classes. Online sessions can cover a specialist subject no one nearby teaches.
What do I see before choosing a tutor on Kanke Road?

A shortlist of two or three matched tutors, with tutors living nearest your colony first, each showing their subjects and own fee on the profile. The first class with the one you pick is a free demo, and if the fit turns out wrong later, you can switch tutor without paying anything extra.

intro: Lalpur, Kokar & Namkum stretches from the busy centre of Ranchi to its quieter south-eastern edge. Lalpur, built around the chowk where Circular Road meets Old Hazaribagh Road, is a business district whose homes sit in compounds and lanes such as Burdwan Compound, with apartment buildings and older houses side by side. Kokar mixes an industrial area and offices with residential pockets like Tiril Basti and Bank Colony, mostly mid-income buildings of two-bedroom flats. Namkum, further out, has plots, independent houses and newer gated enclaves in Barganwa, Tetry Toli and Amethiya Nagar, and feels greener than the centre.

For a tutor, the zone changes character along the way. Lalpur is easy to reach from anywhere, with Ranchi Junction close by and autos and e-rickshaws running most of the day, but roads around the chowk stay busy for long stretches and parking is tight. Kokar sits on the Ranchi-Patna road and Hazaribagh Road, and the Kantatoli flyover, opened in October 2024, lifts cross-town traffic over the Kantatoli junction. Namkum has Namkon station on the Gomoh-Hatia line and roads through Doranda, but homes are spread out, so a tutor with a two-wheeler copes most easily there.

Centrally placed families can often choose from tutors all over Ranchi, while those in Namkum depend more on tutors nearby. NXTutors orders every shortlist the same way: tutors living in Lalpur, Kokar or Namkum, then those who travel to this side of the city, then others in Ranchi, then online tutors for specialist subjects. You receive two or three matched tutors, each tutor's fee is visible before the demo, and that first class is free. If the arrangement stops suiting your child, perhaps after a new school timetable, switching to another tutor costs nothing.
faqs: Where should a tutor park when coming to Lalpur?

Ideally nowhere near the chowk. Parking along the main roads is limited, so many tutors take an auto or e-rickshaw for the last leg, or come by train to Ranchi Junction nearby. Homes in compounds such as Burdwan Compound are a short walk from the main road, so give the compound name and a landmark.
Did the Kantatoli flyover make Kokar easier to reach?

Yes, for cross-town trips. The flyover, opened in October 2024, carries traffic from the Kokar side over the busy Kantatoli junction towards Bahu Bazar. Tutors from the south and centre now lose less time there, though the main roads still peak in the evening, so plan the lesson slot around that rush.
What helps a tutor find a home in Namkum?

Precise location details. Homes are spread across pockets such as Barganwa, Tetry Toli and Amethiya Nagar, so send a location pin and say which entrance to use, since gated enclaves take visitor details there. Most tutors come on their own two-wheeler; Namkon station on the Gomoh-Hatia line helps those arriving by train.
How much does a home tutor in Lalpur or Kokar cost?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor sets their own fee and shows it on the profile, so you can compare before the free demo.

intro: Harmu, Argora & Ratu Road covers western Ranchi, where much of the housing sits in planned colonies. Harmu Housing Colony, set up in the early 1960s and still among the city's biggest residential areas, now pairs independent houses with high-rise flats; Ashok Nagar next door is divided into plots; Kadru, home to the A. G. Colony, is a tight grid of houses and small buildings; Argora combines older houses with gated apartment societies; Pundag has newer enclaves of three-bedroom flats; and the Ratu Road corridor, through Piska More and Vikas Nagar, keeps its homes in the lanes behind the shops. In plotted colonies many tutors ring the bell directly.

Tutors coming by train can use Argora's own station, close to most colonies, or Ranchi Junction a little further off. By road, everything hangs off Bypass Road, known locally as Harmu Road, with Argora Road, Pundag Road and the road from Kadru to Kumhartoli joining it. On Ratu Road, an elevated section open since July 2025 lifts long-distance traffic off the street where families live. Bypass Road and Argora Chowk still clog at peak hours and Kadru's lanes are narrow, so a tutor on a scooter or motorbike who sets off early keeps evening slots most reliably.

Because so many homes here are plotted houses, the first class is usually simple to arrange once the right tutor is found. The NXTutors list opens with tutors based in Harmu, Argora, Ashok Nagar, Kadru, Pundag or along Ratu Road, adds tutors who travel to the west side, then others from Ranchi, and online tutors after that. Each request returns a shortlist of two or three, and every tutor's fee is visible before you commit. The first class is a free demo; if the fit changes later in the year, you can switch tutor at no cost.
faqs: Is Ratu Road still slow for a visiting tutor?

Less than before. Since July 2025 an elevated road has taken through traffic over the stretch past Piska More, so the street below, where the homes and shops are, moves more freely. Office hours still bring crowds, so allow some slack before an evening lesson, and expect apartment buildings to ask the tutor to sign in.
Can a tutor park at the door in Ashok Nagar and Harmu?

Usually, yes. Ashok Nagar was founded by a cooperative of state government employees and is divided into plots, and the Harmu colony is decades old, so many families live in independent houses on colony roads with space to park. Newer apartment blocks in both colonies might want the tutor's name before letting them in.
Why does a scooter beat a car for tutors visiting Kadru?

Kadru's lanes are tight and there is little space to leave a car. Once a tutor arrives, though, entry is simple, since most homes are houses or modest buildings with no guarded gate. Tutors travelling by rail can use Argora or Ranchi Junction, and a direct road connects Kadru with Harmu for those coming from that side.
Is the first lesson free for families in Pundag?

Yes. The first class with any tutor you choose from your shortlist is a free demo, at home or online. Pundag's newer enclaves keep a visitor log, so pass the tutor's name to the guards ahead of that visit. You see the tutor's fee on the profile beforehand, and switching to another tutor later is free.

intro: Doranda, Hinoo & Hatia covers the south of Ranchi, from one of its older business districts to the planned township around the heavy engineering plant. Doranda has homes in South Office Para, North Office Para and Shyamali Colony around its markets, with older houses, staff colonies and flats of two and three bedrooms. Hinoo, where the airport takes up much of the land, is mostly independent houses and small buildings. Dhurwa is laid out in sectors with company quarters, houses, plots and affordable apartments, Hatia adjoins it with staff colonies and houses, and Tupudana, on the Khunti road, adds newer enclaves of three-bedroom flats.

Rail and wide roads make much of the zone straightforward for a tutor. Hatia station serves the south and is both a terminus and a transit stop, while Argora and Ranchi Junction are nearest for Doranda and Hinoo. The township's sector roads in Dhurwa and Hatia mean easy parking and doorstep visits, and residents describe them as less congested than the centre. Doranda's market roads are the busy part in the evening, and roads near the cricket stadium fill up on match days. Further south, Tupudana's homes are spread out near the Ring Road, so tutors usually ride their own two-wheeler.

The south is large, so which tutor you are matched with depends a lot on where exactly you live. NXTutors lists tutors living in Doranda, Hinoo, Dhurwa, Hatia or Tupudana first, then tutors who travel to the south of Ranchi, then others in the city, then online tutors, who suit outer areas when a specialist is needed. You get two or three matched tutors with fees shown before you book, and the first class with your chosen tutor is a free demo. You can also switch to another tutor later at no charge.
faqs: Can a tutor come to Hatia or Dhurwa by train?

Yes. Hatia station, on the Ranchi division of the South Eastern Railway, serves the south of the city, and a tutor from elsewhere in Ranchi can take the train and an auto for the last leg. Inside the township, wide sector roads make parking easy, though some staff colonies ask visitors to sign in.
Do cricket matches affect lessons in Dhurwa?

They can. The international cricket stadium stands within the engineering township, and roads near it fill up on match days. Move that day's lesson to the morning or online, then return to the usual slot. On other days Dhurwa's roads are calmer than the centre, which suits regular evening lessons at home.
Is Hinoo convenient for home tuition near the airport?

Mostly. Homes around the airport are largely independent houses and small apartment buildings, so the tutor usually goes straight to the door. Argora station and Ranchi Junction are nearest by rail. Roads near the airport and towards Doranda get busy at peak hours, so an after-school slot needs a little buffer.
How does NXTutors choose tutors for Tupudana on the southern edge?

Nearest first. Tutors who live in Tupudana or nearby Hatia and Dhurwa come first, then those who travel to the south, then others from Ranchi, then online tutors for a specialist board or exam. Each profile shows the tutor's own fee, and the first class with the one you choose is a free demo.
